rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; f8949 p. 1, box G: "Short-term transactions reported on Form(s) 1099-DA showing basis was reported to the IRS"; i8949 p. 8, code B. executable-triage-v2 (`reviews/2025/transcription/triage/sales.deepseek.json`, written by triage.py this round; 1,495 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 510 partial records from 40 bases; 1,837 comparisons; every witness re-read from an uncapped scratch re-run of triage.mjs, /tmp/adj-bklg-income/full/, same counts): 1,828 of 1,837 agree; 7 value, 1 candidate-unknown, 1 project-unknown, all on refused returns, none on a completed return. The reply adds boxes G and J to the reported-basis boxes; the 7 values are all box G or J entries (generated 8 sales[s1] $2,853.86 against $2,224.76, 21 s2, 92 s1, 160 s2, 256 s3, 357 s1, 470 s1), every one refused: Boxes G and J (and H, I, K, L) are refused for the return by sales.digital at sales.one (fixture sales.refuse.digital.G passes: Form 1040 lines 7a and 16 refused on sales.digital). The unknowns are partials of stage14.sep.step1_other_se_income withholding reported_basis (candidate) or correct_basis (project), on a refused return. The fix-round-2 finding F1 (an unanswered sales.special or sales.aggregate_eligible let the return complete) is fixed as BUG-0257: no candidate-unknown witness is now on a completed return (29 in fix round 2). Project stands.

Ruling: scope; i8949 p. 10, code W; i8949 p. 8, code B. executable-triage-v2 (`reviews/2025/transcription/triage/sales.deepseek.json`, written by triage.py this round; 1,495 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 510 partial records from 40 bases; 1,837 comparisons; every witness re-read from an uncapped scratch re-run of triage.mjs, /tmp/adj-bklg-income/full/, same counts): 1,827 of 1,837 agree; 3 project-refuses, 1 candidate-refuses, 6 project-unknown; none on a completed return. The 3 project-refuses are the new gate sales.wash_bad at sales.w (sales.refuse.wash_over_loss: proceeds $1,000, basis $1,200, wash $449, candidate (g) $449.00; generated 256 sales[s2], candidate $121.39; generated 310 sales[s3], candidate $26.75); the reply declares the same limit on column (h) (h_wash_too_big: wash-sale loss above max(0, basis less proceeds), with the corrected basis for code B), so it refuses the same entries one line later and the return is refused either way. The candidate-refuses is h_code_other on sales.refuse.code, which the project refuses at sales.one (sales.bad_code). The project-unknown are the partials of classm.asset.1 and classm.sdtw.4 withholding box, proceeds or correct_basis, answers asked of every sale. The income package's gate sales.wash_bad (code W, wash-sale loss above zero, and sales.wash_over = columns (d) less (e) plus the code B correction plus the wash-sale loss above zero) refuses at sales.w when the entered loss is larger than the loss on the sale: i8949 p. 10, code W, "You have a nondeductible loss from a wash sale" and "enter the amount of the nondeductible loss as a positive number in column (g)"; p550 p. 86, "A wash sale occurs when you sell or trade stock or securities at a loss". sales.wash_over is column (h), so the gate refuses exactly when column (h) would exceed zero; a wash-sale loss equal to the loss gives (h) $0 and is accepted (sales.adjust.A.W.equal_loss: (g) $200.00, (h) $0.00, line 7a $0.00, evaluated), and the code B correction counts toward the loss (sales.adjust.D.BW.wash_within_corrected_loss: (g) $500.00, (h) -$500.00, evaluated). It neither refuses an allowable entry nor admits an over-large one; no error introduced. Project stands.

Ruling: scope and finding (F1); i8949 p. 8, code B: "You received a Form 1099-B or Form 1099-DA (or substitute statement) and the basis shown in box 1e on Form 1099-B or box 1g on Form 1099-DA is incorrect"; f8949 p. 1, box G: "Short-term transactions reported on Form(s) 1099-DA showing basis was reported to the IRS"; i8949 p. 10, code W: "You have a nondeductible loss from a wash sale ... enter the amount of the nondeductible loss as a positive number in column (g)". executable-triage-v2 (`reviews/2025/transcription/triage/sales.deepseek.json`; 1,382 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 630 partial records from 40 bases; 2,245 comparisons; every witness re-read from an uncapped scratch re-run of triage.mjs, same counts): 2,172 of 2,245 agree; 70 candidate-unknown (28 completed), 3 candidate-refuses (none completed). The reply's code B correction also covers boxes G and J; Boxes G and J (and H, I, K, L) are refused for the return by sales.digital at sales.one (checked: sales.refuse.digital.G and generated 8, 21, 92, 160, 256, 357, 470 refuse Form 1040 lines 7a and 16 on sales.digital). No value differs. The 28 completed candidate-unknown are the F1 partial records withholding sales.special: Finding F1 (SCREEN-UNANSWERED-PASSES, `sales.findings.md`): with sales.special or sales.aggregate_eligible unanswered, sales.one is unknown, but sd.screen (sd.count < 0) evaluates false through the engine's Count lower-bound shortcut, so the return completes as if the screen were answered no; the candidate correctly needs the answer. Witnesses: partial(classm.f8889.1.deepseek -special), project Form 1040 line 16 $18,089.13 computed, candidate unknown; with special true the return refuses. The candidate-refuses (special, h_code_other) are on refused returns, where the project refuses at sales.one on special and bad_code: scope. BUG-0231 widened only the sales.special question (shares of an exchange-traded fund or trust holding gold, silver, platinum or other metals), which matches i1040sd p. 11 ("metals" and an interest in a "trust ... attributable to unrealized appreciation of collectibles"); a wider reading of it can only refuse. Project stands on this line.
